world_news.summary:
Follow the day’s news live

  • Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

Finance minister says Coalition proposal to cut fuel excise during periods of high oil prices ‘unfunded, uncounted promise’

Katy Gallagher, the federal finance minister, said the government doesn’t think a Coalition plan to halve the fuel excise whenever oil prices skyrocket is a “good idea”, saying it is an “unfunded, uncounted promise” from Angus Taylor.

Obviously, we’ve helped when the war started with some changes to the fuel excise, but we’ve shifted and [are] including in the budget to providing more permanent cost of living arrangements, including through the tax system, to make sure that that ongoing cost of living help is there permanently, not just in these one-off arrangements, which, when we’ve got higher inflation, could be difficult in the economy.

Our decisions have been built and baked into the budget to make sure that that cost of living help is permanent. You know, the sooner this war in the Middle East stops, the better.

world_news.summary:
Australia and Finland are vying for a spot on the council, and the PM needs two thirds of member states to back him

  • Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates

Anthony Albanese launched a formal bid for Australia to serve a two-year term on powerful UN body in 2029 and 2030.

Albanese also unveiled former News Corp head of broadcasting Siobhan McKenna as Australia’s next consul-general to New York.

world_news.headline: More than a dozen arrested in connection with 2021 assassination of Haitian president
world_news.summary:
Jovenel Moïse, 53, was shot dead in July 2021 in a killing which sparked chaos in Haiti

Eighteen people have been arrested in association with the 2021 assassination of the Haitian president Jovenel Moïse, according to US officials.

Moïse, 53, was shot dead on 7 July 2021 at his private residence by a hired group of about 20 military-trained Colombian mercenaries. His security detail did not intervene to protect him.
